sources.title: GitHub - arshandalili/sasa
sources.snippet: Code to reproduce the GPT-2 results of the SASA paper. SASA replaces each one-dimensional SAE decoder atom with a learned decoder subspace, enforces Top- s group sparsity, and adds a nuclear-norm regularizer.
